messages:
taylor: Heads-up — macOS smoke CI just went red after the CMake/toolchain roll. Failing in objc++ module cache during compile. Anyone on call?

samir: link?

taylor: https://ci.internal.redwood/builds/12345 — failing on macOS-latest, shard 3

ci-bot: Build 12345 macOS-smoke shard-3 FAILED — exit code 1. Logs available at https://ci.internal.redwood/logs/12345/shard3

jamal: Can you paste the top of the error? sounds like module cache invalidation

taylor: pasted:
```
/Users/runner/work/redwood/src/engine/objc_bridge.mm:10:10: fatal error: module 'Accelerate' not found
#import <Accelerate/Accelerate.h>
         ^
1 error generated.
```

jen: that looks like Xcode SDK path missing in the toolchain. Did the toolchain roll change SDKROOT or sysroot flags?

eva: ccache + remote cache can hide ABI changes. Can you try a clean worker (no cache) quick rerun?

taylor: kicked a rerun with caches disabled: CI rerun 12346 (no-remote-cache, CC=clang-13). Fingers crossed.

samir: quick bisect request — range: main~30..main. Any commits touching toolchain scripts or mac packages?

jamal: I'll take the bisect. If it's the toolchain image, we can also try pinning the macOS SDK to 12.5 as a stopgap.

ci-bot: Rerun 12346 started — worker id mac-011, caches disabled

taylor: rerun failed too, same error. Last change that could affect this is the toolchain Docker image bump to clang13+Xcode14 on main at commit 9f3b2a7.

samir: jamal — can you run a local reproduce with the new image? I can temporarily revert the image in the CI matrix if you confirm repro.

jamal: running reproduce now with Docker image redwood/tools:clang13-xcode14. Output looks the same. I'll start a bisect job and report back in ~20m.

(twenty minutes later)

jamal: bisect narrowed to commit 9f3b2a7 -> 9f3b2a7^? actually it's the image tag bump in infra/ci/docker/macos.json. Root cause: SDK path arg was dropped in the packaging step. Opening a quick PR to re-add SDKROOT. cc @eng-infra

taylor: awesome, thanks. Can we revert the image tag in the CI matrix meanwhile so PR can land safely?

samir: I'll queue a rollback for macos-image to previous tag and kick off a clean run.

ci-bot: Rollback PR created #5678. Clean run started (build 12347)

taylor: build 12347 passed. Marking as mitigated. Jamal — please include a regression test for image packaging so we don't lose SDK settings next roll.

jamal: will do, adding a packaging smoke test and a note in the release checklist.

taylor: thanks all :tada:
